title: SG-5.6.1 Land the Phaser alias in a Verify-owned unit
summary: Phaser alias for game tests lands via a Verify unit and its test stays green
description: Context: game/vitest.config.ts only aliases @game, so a bare 'phaser' import from BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts L1) does not resolve from game/tests. Desired behavior: the phaser alias is added to the game test configuration as part of a Verify-owned unit so it is not rejected as a test file changed by Act, and an alias unit test passes. Why: scene unit tests with Phaser mocked must resolve it.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/vitest.config.ts, when read, then resolve.alias maps 'phaser' to the frontend phaser install and keeps '@game'
Given the alias test, when run, then it passes
Given the diff, when reviewed, then vitest.config.ts is changed only by a Verify unit
technical_constraints: Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 in game/frontend/package.json
definition_of_done: Alias present and alias test passes
